metrics.label: 订单数
metrics.description: 已支付订单数（含之后退款的订单，不含已取消订单）。

notes: 数据范围：上海徐汇店（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），区域“华东”的订单数为 128 单。

queries.title: 订单数
queries.sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    store_id IN ('S01')
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    region_name
  FROM regions
  WHERE
    region_id IN (
      SELECT
        region_id
      FROM stores
      WHERE
        store_id IN ('S01')
    )
) AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
